Prior review retained below:
Distinct second pass reviewed all 240 interpretations against the exact bank and pole directions, and challenged counterevidence and mixed answers. Verified Carney via September 2026 official material; used newer 2026–28 immigration plan and enacted March 2026 C-12 eligibility restrictions, operative December 2025 procurement framework and September 2026 counter-tariffs. Added specific evidence during review for cannabis, firearms exceptions, peace bonds, judicial interception, seatbelts, movement-data retention and disclosure defences. Preserved separation of financing from ownership (especially privately owned VIA tracks), federalism from municipal autonomy, and religious heritage from clerical state authority. Culture–Nature uses explicit mixed biological/social guidance for behaviour, stress, attention and threat; no inference from religion, environmental policy or an ideology label. The national-IQ, general interests and immediate moral-reaction questions are the least direct institutional inferences and need particular scrutiny in the independent parent audit. These are not claims of government-measured heritability. Prospective project, tax and AI announcements are identified as such and do not establish completed implementation. Source dates marked undated where a reliable publication date was not established. Commons description and PD-flag terms checked; downloaded 960x480 PNG visually inspected. This is an AI self-review, not a human or separate-agent sign-off; parent will perform the requested independent audit and integration. No scores targeted or neighbour answers consulted. Parent-audit follow-up: additional official and provincial searches found no adopted framework supporting Culture–Nature Q2, Q5 or Q10; these are now unknown. Q6 changed from disagreement to supported mixed interaction on PHAC policy plus broader Ontario risk-taking guidance. Archive remains blocked pending these three gaps; no unknown was replaced by Neutral. Focused continuation on 2026-10-05 by primary OpenAI Codex agent /root: Reread the public-health determinants framework and searched official English/French material for inherited versus experiential causes of interests and national intelligence. Read relevant passages of DRDC CR 2005-105 (printed pp.31–33,51–56) and The Warrior’s Way (2007, opening matter and pp.24–25). These are a contracted research review and an authored Defence Academy treatise; publication is not proof of current adoption of a causal ranking. Intuition versus deliberation differs from biology versus upbringing. All 3 exact question-level gaps remain null/unknown. Existing supported answers, period and cutoff are preserved. This was a focused same-agent research and separate challenge pass, not a complete independent re-review or publication sign-off. Separate completion pass on 2026-10-05: checked the 3 new educated assumptions against exact question wording, agreement direction, contextual sources and prior withdrawal reasons. These are most-likely provisional estimates, not adopted national causal theories. The distinction between individual and national/racial heredity, immediate intuition and deliberate instruction, and interventions and causal predominance is retained. Assumption IDs: culture-nature-02, culture-nature-05, culture-nature-10. Reviewed neutral-heavy axis rationales: explicit mixed institutions, competing implemented rules and interaction models justify retained neutral choices; uncertainty alone was not used as the neutral rationale. Earlier whole-assessment review is preserved; this continuation does not claim a fresh independent 240-source reread or a human review. Similarity and browser checks are recorded separately after integration.
